name: Storefront home page loads
description: The storefront root URL serves the deployed index page.
steps: Wait for the page to render
Confirm the site header and hero are present
expected: The Apex iPhone storefront renders at the site root.

name: Storefront stylesheet is applied
description: The bundled CSS loads, proving the relative asset paths resolve after the build.
steps: Inspect the computed background colour of the body
expected: The page renders with the dark storefront theme rather than unstyled HTML.

name: Shop page is reachable
description: The shop page builds as its own entry point and keeps its asset references.
steps: Navigate to the shop page URL
Confirm the product grid area renders
expected: The shop page loads as its own document with no missing stylesheet.

name: Storefront is usable on mobile
description: The storefront reflows correctly on a phone viewport.
steps: Open the storefront home page on a mobile viewport
expected: Content fits the viewport width with no horizontal scrollbar.
